title: After Gene: the Chesterfield studio show
summary: Roy joined the studio show, learned of the pickets, and calls it a farce.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: After Gene, let's see... You mean after I broke with the band?

Then I went to... I started... After Gene I came back here, worked around here, and then... I think then I went in the studio with that Chesterfield show. And you know I didn't find out until later years that they had pickets on that show. Did you know that?
Yeah, that's what I heard from a lot of sources. Because we had Teddy...

Yeah, the Chesterfield show. That was a farce, too, man! That's just one thing... I got out of there in a hurry, man. And also, the producer...in fact, he committed suicide. He was a good cat. Did you ever hear of a trumpet player named Lloyd Hundley? He was a good trumpet player. A Black cat. Some records are going to show up sooner or later with Shorty Sherock, myself, and Lloyd Hundley, and Tony DiAmore on piano. We played "The Sheik" and some other things, you know.
